name: SEO for AI
author: SEO for AI

sections.description:
Maximize Your SEO Investment for the AI Era
As AI engines refresh their data, you have a unique opportunity to get ahead of your competition.
As Search slowly dies and AI evolves as a primary discovery channel, ensuring your website is optimized for these new technologies is essential. SEO for AI keeps you ahead of the curve, making sure your content remains discoverable as technology progresses.

Don’t let your valuable content become invisible to the next generation of search. Optimize for AI today with AI Content Optimization (AIO).

Perfect for
* Content publishers wanting maximum exposure in AI responses.
* Online stores needing accurate product information in AI results.
* Educational sites and Professional service providers wanting accurate citations in AI-generated content.
* Brand-conscious companies ensuring their brand voice and messaging isn’t diluted in AI responses

Free (this version):
* Fundamental enhancements to the metadata of your site.
* Continual updates to keep your content organised and accessible in AI.

Premium (available as an upgrade within this plugin):
* More advanced structures included in your metadata to allow AI to understand your content even better.
* The ability to automatically update your robots.txt to allow AI bots to access your content. Plugin updates will allow new bots to access your content.
sections.faq:
**Does this free version actually help my site get discovered by AI engines like ChatGPT and Claude?**

This version adds specialized AI-friendly metadata to your content that helps AI engines better understand and index your website. The plugin adds custom meta tags that provide clear context about your content, making it more likely to be cited and referenced when AI assistants answer user questions related to your topics.

**Does this replace my existing SEO plugin like Yoast or RankMath?**

No, SEO for AI is designed to work alongside your existing SEO plugins, not replace them. Think of it as an additional layer of optimization specifically for the emerging AI search landscape. We actually recommend keeping your traditional SEO work active while adding SEO for AI to future-proof your content discovery strategy.

**What’s the difference between the free and premium versions?**

The free version provides essential AI metadata optimization to help AI engines understand your content better. The premium version adds advanced structured data markup and robots.txt management for comprehensive AI crawler control, giving you maximum visibility and control over how AI systems interact with your site.

**How do I know if the plugin is working correctly?**

Easy! Visit the plugin page on your admin screen and it will tell you at the bottom of the page.

**Will this slow down my website?**

Not at all! The plugin adds lightweight metadata tags that have minimal impact on page load times. The AI-friendly tags are small text additions to your HTML head section, similar to how traditional SEO plugins work, so there’s no performance concern.

**Which AI engines will this help with?**

SEO for AI is designed to work with major AI platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google’s Gemini, and other AI-powered search tools. As the AI landscape evolves, we continuously update our optimization techniques to work with new platforms and crawlers.
